Copy prompt
Search for unclaimed money or property in my name using these names and past addresses: [full name and any previous names], [list of past addresses and states]. Check each relevant state's official unclaimed property site and the national databases, and list anything found with the amount and holder. Before you fill out or submit any claim form or upload any ID, pause and show me what you are about to enter, and tell me which ID or verification documents I'll need to prepare.
